sections.title: I. Portul stelelor
sections.direction: Begin quietly with harp harmonics and celesta introducing the four-note motif, long warm strings enter gradually. A welcoming space harbour, patient and luminous. No grand opening hit.

sections.title: II. Aripi de lumină
sections.direction: Develop the same motif in soft French horn above gently flowing strings. A graceful sense of departure, dignified lift, no action-movie intensity.

sections.title: III. Grădina dintre lumi
sections.direction: Woodwinds answer the motif in delicate counterpoint, harp ripples and restrained pizzicato, playful discovery with elegance rather than cartoon comedy.

sections.title: IV. Întrebarea
sections.direction: Thin the orchestra, introduce suspended harmony and distant celesta echoes of the motif. Curious uncertainty, never horror or menace. Leave generous breathing space.

sections.title: V. Împreună
sections.direction: Resolve the uncertainty as the motif returns in warm strings and rounded horns, the fullest but still restrained orchestration. Tender collective discovery, no percussion climax.

sections.title: VI. Acasă, printre stele
sections.direction: Return to the opening harp and celesta motif, softened strings and a reassuring homecoming. Gentle complete cadence in D major, long natural decay ending in silence.
